- Boat A is fully loaded with \(400 + 300 = 700 \text{ kg}\).
- Boat B is fully loaded with \(150 + 200 = 350 \text{ kg}\).
- Both boats carry at least one crate.
- All crates are moved in a single crossing.

Thus, it is indeed possible to move all four crates onto the two boats in a single crossing.
